item.title: Scientists "bottle the sun" with a liquid battery that stores solar energy
item.description:
📝 Science News from research organizations Scientists “bottle the sun” with a liquid battery that stores solar energy Researchers created a “rechargeable sun battery” that stores sunlight in molecules and later releases enough heat to boil water. " A Reusable "Sun Battery" Unlike standard solar panels that directly convert sunlight into electricity, this system stores energy chemically. " The molecule also delivers impressive energy density.
🔗 Read more: https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/05/260513221821.htm
